gaps: Every breath-one mechanism was written as the learner's inquiry committing the learner: a record, a duty, a consumed specimen, a moved default, a spent asset. Pressing on Confidant with a duty showed that the escape can be a person rather than a form, which raised the question of what else can absorb a moved question; pressing on Fuse shorter than the finding showed that the market prices 'find out first' directly, so the escape has a price and the price is a measure; pressing on Knowing obliges produced the question breath one could not hold, whether a question not asked can commit as the asked one does. Changed question for breath two: who or what absorbs the commitment when the question is moved, a form, a person, a sibling object, a later date, a cover story, and is there a question that commits the party asked rather than the asker, or that commits when it is not asked at all.
accepted: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the bureaus' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.

Asking the gatekeeper: the question is put to the party who holds the option, so the asking tells the holder that the option is wanted and the holder reprices it before answering; as the founder who asks her existing investor whether the fund would bridge and learns nothing about the bridge she did not already know but tells the fund the round is not coming, so the bridge, if offered, arrives with terms written for a company that needs it, or the tenant who asks the landlord what breaking the lease would cost and is thereafter a tenant who is leaving, or the buyer whose request for a quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming; the inquiry is the direct ask; the commitment is the holder's updated price, borne by the asker, and it is created by the asking whether or not the answer is yes; the less committing inquiry is one made through a party with no stake, the lawyer who reads the lease for its break clause, the counsel who knows what bridges that fund has done, the question asked about a third company; not Hard pull, where the record of the ask is read by strangers, since here the only reader is the one who holds the answer and the price moves in a single hand; adds to investor-tells' Borrowed eyes the mirror case, the founder's ask read by the investor.

Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the patient who asks whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.

Tainted by looking: seeing the thing forecloses building it independently, because the look can never afterward be unproven; as the acquirer whose engineers read the target's code in diligence and who, if the deal fails, cannot build a rival module without facing the claim that they copied, so the look removed the build option that existed before it; the inquiry is the technical diligence; the commitment is contamination, borne by the looker in every later dispute, and created the moment the look occurs, before any answer is drawn from it; the less committing inquiry is the clean room, a separate team that never looks and is shown only a specification, or the third-party auditor who examines the code and reports pass or fail without content, each of which answers a narrower question so that the wide one stays askable; the residuals clause, which licenses what the looker's engineers happen to remember, is the negotiated price of looking without a room; not deal-deaths' Paid in the tasting, where the look supplies enough of the good that the deal is not needed, since here the look removes the looker's own alternative.

Breaking to know: the inquiry consumes the object it was to decide about, so the answer arrives for a thing that is gone and the decision moves to its siblings; as the weld sectioned to learn its penetration, the lot of cartridges proof-fired to learn its pressure, the bottle opened to learn whether the vintage has kept, so what is learned is about the batch and the choice 'use this one' is spent by the asking; the inquiry is the destructive test; the commitment is the loss of the specimen and the inference from sibling to sibling, borne by whoever must now trust that the untested ones are alike; the less committing inquiry is the non-destructive one, ultrasound or radiography for the weld, a proof load below failure for the beam, which answers about this object and worse, and consumes a little of it anyway, since a proof load spends fatigue life; not witness-architectures' Half kept back, which reserves a duplicate so the reading's error leaves a trace, since here the concern is not the record of the reading but that the thing decided about is what the reading destroyed.

Question plants itself: asking a party what it would do installs in that party a decision it was not facing, so the answer describes a party the question has changed; as the manager who asks the engineer whether she is thinking of leaving, and converts an unexamined staying into a staying that has now been chosen or not, or the spouse who asks whether the other would stay if the money ran out; the inquiry is the direct question to the subject; the commitment is that the subject now holds the option as an option, borne by the asker, who cannot again have the subject who had not thought of it; the less committing inquiry is to ask the class rather than the person, the anonymous engagement survey, or to watch rather than ask, calendar gaps and recruiter mail, each of which answers about a population or a posture and not about her; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party prices something the asker wants, since here nothing is priced and what changes is which futures the asked party can see; speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured.

Answer only inside the incision: the answer of the grade needed exists only in a state that itself demands a decision, so the deciding must happen on a provisional answer within a window the inquiry opened; as the surgeon who sends a frozen section from the operating table and gets a preliminary read while the patient is open, so that resect or close must be chosen in the anesthesia window on the fast read, since the permanent pathology arrives in days and the patient cannot be held open for it; the inquiry is the intraoperative sample; the commitment is the decision made in the window on the lesser answer, borne by the patient, and the window is made by the inquiry itself; the less committing inquiry is the preoperative biopsy, which answers earlier and worse, and which in some tumours carries its own commitment through seeding along the needle track, so the earlier question is not free; not Breaking to know, where the specimen is consumed and the decision moves to its siblings, since here the patient is whole and the decision is moved into the window.

Fuse shorter than the finding: the inquiry takes longer than the option lives, so finding out first is a way of letting the option expire; as the buyer whose structural survey needs three weeks against an offer that must be accepted by Friday, the employer whose reference checks outlast the candidate's competing offer, the investor whose diligence outlasts the expiry a rival wrote on its term sheet; the inquiry is any that needs the calendar; the commitment is the option's death during the finding, borne by the finder, who learns the answer to a question that no longer has a choice attached; the less committing inquiry is the purchased interval, the option fee, the earnest money at risk, the exclusivity bought with a break fee, the inspection period written into the contract, so that 'find out first' is available at a price and the price is the market's measure of what the finding commits; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, where the counterparty's paper serialises the search, since here nothing forbids the parallel and the calendar alone closes it; not runway-illusions' Runway in shots, which counts the trials a runway holds, since here the runway is the option's and not the finder's.

Pilot that grandfathers itself: a trial run to find out whether a thing works becomes the default while it runs, so the answer arrives to a party for whom stopping is now a change; as the contractor brought in to see how it goes who after a year is the person the team cannot lose, the pilot with a customer whose integration is built during the pilot so that not renewing is a churn, the prototype that ships because it works, the trial separation that installs two households; the inquiry is the trial; the commitment is the moved status quo, borne by whoever must now act to end what began as a look; the less committing inquiry is the trial with its end fixed at the start, a date, a decision rule written before the data, a pilot built on plumbing meant to be thrown away, and each of these is faked often enough that a counterparty reads whether the end is real; not deal-deaths' Ghost closing, where a deal is lived before it is signed and loses its urgency, since there the parties wanted the deal and here they wanted to know; adds to risk-rebound-effects' The hardened patch the case where the thing that ossified was an experiment.

Knowing obliges: a duty attaches to the finding, so the learner who finds cannot afterward choose to have not found; as the manufacturer whose engineers test a fielded part and find a failure mode, and who now must recall or notify rather than decide whether to, the seller who tests the well and must disclose the result to every buyer, the radiologist who orders the scan for one thing and must report the nodule found for another; the inquiry is the test; the commitment is the duty, borne by the learner, and it is created by the answer's existence rather than its use; the less committing inquiry is the unrecorded reading, the consultant asked to say it aloud and not write it, the sample kept off the books, each of which is a hazard of its own since the law often treats the oral finding as known; not deal-deaths' Report that must be acted on, where the written record obliges the buyer's lender or board, since here the duty is the finder's own and needs no third party to read it.

Finding starts the fuse: the finding starts a clock the learner did not choose, so the choice the answer bears on begins to expire from the moment it is known or should have been; as the owner who discovers the foundation crack and thereby starts the limitations period against the builder, the insured whose claims-made policy requires notice as soon as practicable after the insured knows, the company whose determination that a breach is material starts the days it has to file; the inquiry is any that finds; the commitment is the fuse, borne by the learner, who now has a dated period in which 'decide afterward' must occur; the less committing inquiry does not exist by design, since the discovery rule runs from when a reasonable party would have discovered, so not looking does not stop the clock, only hides its reading; not runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission that expires on a date no cash extends, since here the date is set by the finding and not by the calendar; and not Knowing obliges, where the finding removes a choice, since here it dates one.

Known only by staking it: the answer can be had only by putting at risk the thing whose value the answer decides, so the inquiry is a wager on the asset; as the patent whose validity is known only by asserting it, since assertion invites the invalidity challenge that, lost, ends the patent everywhere, so a weak patent is worth most unasserted and its holder cannot learn its strength without spending it, or the form contract whose enforceability is known only by suing on it, where a loss binds every copy in the book; the inquiry is the assertion; the commitment is the asset staked, borne by the holder, and the answer, if adverse, is the asset's end; the less committing inquiry is the settlement before judgment, which buys the question back at a price and with a record that tells the next challenger the holder feared the answer, and the private opinion of counsel, which answers only the holder; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, the attacker's move, since here the holder wants to know and the knowing costs the thing; adds to deal-deaths' Price found too precisely the case where what is found too precisely is the asset's own strength.

Only the real thing answers: the answer is defined as the act's outcome, so any inquiry short of the act answers a neighbouring question and the act cannot be tried; as the device whose yield is known by detonation, which spends the device and the treaty, the backup whose restorability is known by restoring, the evacuation plan known by evacuating, the ally known to come by the war; the inquiry is the act; the commitment is total and coincides with the answer, borne by whoever the act commits; the less committing inquiry is the proxy, the simulation, the tabletop, the subcritical test, the restore to a spare machine, each of which answers about the model and not the thing, and the distance between them is where the surprise lives; not Pilot that grandfathers itself, where the trial becomes the thing by running, since here the trial was the thing from the first; and not Breaking to know, which spends a specimen to learn about its siblings, since here there are no siblings and the thing learned about is the thing spent.

residue.item: Estimate that becomes the promise: asking an engineer how long a thing would take produces a number that is thereafter read as a commitment.
residue.why: Held: the commitment attaches to the answer's reading, not to the inquiry, and it binds the answerer; in type only if the asker's own choices change, and no carrier for that was found in this breath.

residue.item: Reference check that alerts the employer: checking a candidate's references tells the current employer the candidate is looking.
residue.why: Rejected: lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling already holds the source's sight of the search; what survives here is Hard pull, where strangers read the count of asks.

residue.item: Measuring changes the measured: any observation of a social system alters it.
residue.why: Rejected as a theme; what survived is Question plants itself, with a carrier, the option lodged in the asked party, and an escape, the class asked instead of the person.

residue.item: Prototype that ships: a thing built to find out whether it can be built is the thing that is deployed.
residue.why: Merged into Pilot that grandfathers itself as one of its cases; the mechanism is the moved default, whether the trial is a person, a customer, or a build.

residue.item: Bid as probe: bidding in an open auction to learn whether others will go higher reveals the bidder's valuation and may win the lot.
residue.why: Merged into Only the real thing answers, since the probe is the bid and the bid may be accepted; the sealed-bid form has no probe at all.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real diligence, a real hire, a real surgery runs several of these at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.
The seriation is an itinerary of where the less committing inquiry lives, not a ranking of how much each inquiry commits or how often the escape works; the map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (credit inquiries and rate-shopping windows, knowledge qualifiers, clean rooms and residuals clauses, frozen sections, discovery rules and claims-made notice, patent assertion, decrypt protection) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; the legal doctrines are one jurisdiction's, vary, and are not advice.

The answer that changes what the finder wants (the buyer who learns of the mould and no longer wants the house) is out, since the choice set is intact and only the valuation moved; the inquiry that merely costs money is out, since an expense is not a commitment unless it changes what can be chosen; what is in is the inquiry that itself removes, dates, prices, or relocates a choice.

option-expiries covers options that lapse without their holder declining; Fuse shorter than the finding is in here only because the inquiry is what does the expiring. advantages-spent-by-use covers an advantage consumed by exercise; Known only by staking it borders it and is in here because the spending is the price of the answer, not of the use.

gaps: The changed question yielded commitments absorbed by parties other than the asker and by the law's charge on the unasked question: an authority whose answer closes the asker's ambiguity (Ruling you can't unask), a seller whose own diligence widens what it warrants and whose escape is a partition of knowers (Self-inquiry widens the warranty), a board that cannot receive a written offer without a process (Bear hug that puts them in play), a covert answer whose every use must be sourced by a second, overt question (Use that burns the source), and finally the question refused and charged anyway (Blindness priced as knowledge), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed the escape of not asking was always available and free. The territory pointer stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now sorts by where the less committing inquiry lives rather than by what the inquiry commits. The seriation's axis came from this: the walk runs from an escape supplied by the same institution that made the question committing to an escape that is itself charged, and the pincer between the knowledge group and imputed knowledge showed that the two ends of the walk meet inside one contract.
accepted: Ruling you can't unask: the authority whose reading of a rule is sought answers on the record, so an adverse answer closes the ambiguity the asker was living in; as the taxpayer who requests a private letter ruling on a structure and, refused, can no longer file it as an honest reading, since the reading was sought and given in writing to this taxpayer and the file now exists, or the exporter who asks customs for a binding classification and is told the higher tariff line and cannot afterward ship under the lower one as a good-faith mistake; the inquiry is the request for the ruling; the commitment is the loss of good-faith ambiguity and the authority's file, borne by the asker; the less committing inquiry is the no-names meeting, in which counsel describes a hypothetical client, and the informal call whose answer binds nobody, each of which carries less weight for the same reason it commits less; not Confidant with a duty, where the asked party's own obligation is triggered by the question, since here the asked party is free and it is the answer that binds; and not Asking the gatekeeper, where the holder reprices what the asker wants, since the authority sells nothing and the price of asking is paid in the asker's later defences.

Self-inquiry widens the warranty: a party that investigates itself expands what it warrants, because its promises are qualified by what it knows; as the seller whose representations are given 'to the seller's knowledge' and who commissions vendor due diligence before the sale, so that every defect the diligence finds is now a defect the seller knows and warrants against, while the defect it never looked for stays outside the promise; the inquiry is the seller's own diligence; the commitment is the widened warranty, borne by the seller at the indemnity claim; the less committing inquiry is the knowledge group, since the contract defines the seller's knowledge as the actual knowledge of named individuals, and a seller who keeps those individuals out of the diligence sessions can learn and not know, an escape bounded by the buyer's insistence that the group include the people who would know and by any clause that adds what they should have known; not Knowing obliges, where a duty attaches to the finding, since here no duty attaches and what widens is the promise's coverage; and not Tainted by looking, which walls the looker from the thing, since here the wall runs inside one party between those who looked and those who sign.

Bear hug that puts them in play: the question changes the asked party's obligations and the asker's retreat at once, because some parties cannot receive a question without a process; as the acquirer who writes to a public target's board proposing to buy it at a price, so that the board, which could have declined a private call with a shrug, must now consider the proposal under its duties, may have to disclose it, and, once it decides to sell, may be obliged to seek the best price rather than this one, while the acquirer, once the letter is known, cannot withdraw without being read as having found something or been refused; the inquiry is the written offer; the commitment is the process the board must run and the asker's loss of an unwatched exit, borne by both; the less committing inquiry is the private, non-binding indication of interest, which triggers no process and which the target's counsel reads for whether it is really private; not first-mover-forecloses' Initiate the test case that shapes the governing precedent, an attack on the responder's options, since here the asker wanted an answer and got a process; not Question plants itself, where what lodges in the asked party is a thought, since here what lodges is a duty; the duties named are a simplified reading of one jurisdiction's public-company law.

Use that burns the source: the answer can be used only in ways that do not reveal how it was obtained, so a class of actions is removed from the learner at the moment of learning; as the reader of an adversary's ciphers who cannot act on every decrypt without telling the adversary the cipher is read, and so must let some convoys sail, or the bidder who learns a seller's reserve from a leak and cannot bid exactly at it without exposing the leak; the inquiry is the covert channel; the commitment is that every act on the answer must be plausibly sourced elsewhere, borne by the learner as a constraint on all later moves; the less committing inquiry is made afterward and is a second question whose only purpose is to be the visible source of the first's answer, the reconnaissance flight sent to 'find' the convoy already located, the case rebuilt in the open from a tip, so the covert inquiry costs a second, overt one; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asking discloses need, since here the asking discloses nothing and the using does; the cipher case is the documented Second World War practice of protecting decrypts, simplified.

Blindness priced as knowledge: the question not asked is charged as if answered, so the escape of not finding out commits as the finding would; as the purchaser who can claim the innocent-landowner defence to a contamination liability only by having made all appropriate inquiries before buying, so that not inspecting is not innocence but the loss of the defence, the buyer under caveat emptor who could have inspected and cannot later rescind, the officer whose deliberate avoidance of a fact is treated by the court as knowledge of it; the inquiry is the one refused; the commitment is imputed knowledge, borne by the refuser, with none of knowledge's uses; the less committing inquiry is the inquiry of exactly the required depth and no deeper, the site assessment that satisfies the standard without the sampling that would find the thing, and the law sets that depth for the purpose; not Knowing obliges, where the finding creates the duty, since here the not-finding does; not Finding starts the fuse, which dates a choice from when the finder should have looked, since here the whole defence is lost and no clock is offered; the doctrines named are simplified from one jurisdiction's environmental and criminal law.

residue.item: Poll that moves the vote: asking the electorate what it thinks changes what it thinks.
residue.why: Rejected: Question plants itself at scale, with no new carrier and no new escape; the class asked instead of the person is already that item's less committing form.

residue.item: Quote that moves the market: a request for quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming and moves the price before the trade.
residue.why: Merged into Asking the gatekeeper as its market case, since the mechanism is the holder repricing on the ask and the escape is the same, an intermediary or a question about a third thing.

residue.item: Second opinion that fires the first: asking another physician, lawyer, or architect commits the relationship with the first.
residue.why: Held: the commitment is social and real, but no carrier was found beyond the first party's feelings, and the map admits a mechanism only with a carrier the asker can name.

residue.item: Opened envelope: a seller who opens sealed bids to learn them can no longer re-run the auction, since the bidders now know each other's numbers through the seller's next move.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: the inquiry consumes the counterparty's ignorance rather than the asker's option, which no admitted item does; adjacent to walkaway-manufactures' Pawn-shop option and deal-deaths' Price found too precisely, and it needs a case where the seller's re-run was actually foreclosed before admission.

The seriation is an itinerary of where the less committing inquiry lives, not a ranking of how much each inquiry commits or how often the escape works; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, incompatibility, dependency, and passages they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (credit inquiries and rate-shopping windows, private letter rulings and binding classifications, knowledge qualifiers and knowledge groups, clean rooms and residuals clauses, frozen sections and needle-track seeding, bear-hug letters and board duties, discovery rules and claims-made notice, decrypt protection, patent assertion, the innocent-landowner defence) are simplified to expose one mechanism each; the legal doctrines are one jurisdiction's, vary, and are not advice.

option-expiries covers options that lapse without their holder declining; Fuse shorter than the finding is in here only because the inquiry is what does the expiring. advantages-spent-by-use covers an advantage consumed by exercise; Known only by staking it borders it and is in here because the spending is the price of the answer, not of the use. The inquiry that commits a third party who never asked, the sibling whose genetic result answers for the sibling who chose not to know, is in type and absent; it would sit beside Breaking to know, with the family as the batch.

neighbors.left: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the bureaus' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.
neighbors.right: Asking the gatekeeper: the question is put to the party who holds the option, so the asking tells the holder that the option is wanted and the holder reprices it before answering; as the founder who asks her existing investor whether the fund would bridge and learns nothing about the bridge she did not already know but tells the fund the round is not coming, so the bridge, if offered, arrives with terms written for a company that needs it, or the tenant who asks the landlord what breaking the lease would cost and is thereafter a tenant who is leaving, or the buyer whose request for a quote in a thin market tells the one dealer that size is coming; the inquiry is the direct ask; the commitment is the holder's updated price, borne by the asker, and it is created by the asking whether or not the answer is yes; the less committing inquiry is one made through a party with no stake, the lawyer who reads the lease for its break clause, the counsel who knows what bridges that fund has done, the question asked about a third company; not Hard pull, where the record of the ask is read by strangers, since here the only reader is the one who holds the answer and the price moves in a single hand; adds to investor-tells' Borrowed eyes the mirror case, the founder's ask read by the investor.
neighbors.separating_case: A founder asks one fund whether it would bridge, and a borrower applies to one lender for a rate. Let each be refused and let each then ask a second party. The founder's second fund knows nothing unless the first fund talks, so the first ask moved one price in one hand and the founder can still arrive at the second fund unpriced by going through a lawyer who knows that fund's bridges; the borrower's second lender reads the first pull on the file before the borrower speaks, so the first ask moved every later price and no intermediary can unmake it, only a softer question could. The separating test is whether the second party can see the first ask without being told: where it cannot, the mechanism is Asking the gatekeeper and the escape is another asker; where it can, the mechanism is Hard pull and the escape is another form. A fund that phones the next fund converts the first into the second, which the first edge says.

checks.boundary_case: The buyer who pays for a survey and learns the house has subsidence, and no longer wants it, is a tempting nonmember and is out: the choice set is exactly what it was, buy or walk, and only the valuation moved, so the answer changed the decision and the inquiry changed nothing. The nonrefundable diligence fee paid to the seller to hold the house while the survey runs is the tempting cousin and is also out, since a price paid for a question is an expense and not a commitment unless it changes what can be chosen. Fuse shorter than the finding is in on exactly that contrast: there the survey's three weeks kill the offer, so the inquiry removed the choice, and the diligence fee reappears inside the item as the purchased interval, the market's price for keeping 'find out first' available. The fence is that an inquiry is in when it removes, dates, prices, relocates, or imputes a choice, and out when it only informs one.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Confidant with a duty, one question put to a lawyer stays a question under privilege, put to a director becomes Knowing obliges in a second body, and put to an auditor becomes a Hard pull's record in the file, so three items far apart on the walk are one choice of ear apart in practice. It shows a loop, Known only by staking it -> Asking the gatekeeper -> Known only by staking it, where the settlement that buys the question back tells the next challenger the holder feared the answer, which brings the next assertion, so the question a holder refuses to have answered is asked again at a rising price until a judgment ends it. It shows an incompatibility between Self-inquiry widens the warranty and Blindness priced as knowledge, the map's two ends of what a party is charged with knowing: wherever knowledge is imputed, the knowledge group that escapes the warranty is closed, so a seller cannot both learn without knowing and be excused for not looking in one jurisdiction, while where only actual knowledge counts both stand. It shows a dependency at Use that burns the source -> Hard pull: the cover question that launders a covert answer is itself a committing inquiry, so one covert answer costs two commitments and the cover is worth running only where the overt question asked cold would have been cheap. And it shows two passages between levels: Confidant with a duty -> Knowing obliges, where a personal question becomes an institutional duty in a body the asker does not control, and Pilot that grandfathers itself -> Only the real thing answers, where an inquiry becomes the act by running, which a line ordered by where the escape lives reads as a jump from the middle to the far end.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each admitted item names a distinct mechanism, its inquiry, its commitment and who bears it, and where a less committing inquiry lives and what it answers instead; the strange members (a question that commits the party asked, a cover question run to launder a covert answer, an inquiry that must be made to exactly the required depth and no deeper, an escape that is a choice of ear) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about doing diligence carefully, and the speculative one, Question plants itself, carries its modality in its text.

next_crossfield_opening: Questions charged whether or not they are asked: connect Blindness priced as knowledge with witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt, where a gap in the record scores as the worst reading, and with survival-floors' use-rules that change the floor by being stood on, and ask which institutions have moved from pricing the answer to pricing the question, so that the operator's only free move is the depth of inquiry the rule names, and whether that depth is set where the thing is or where it is not.

gaps: The map's claim to be a map rests on five relations in form_inference, and two were not carried by their edges as written: the settlement loop never said how a settlement is an ask of a gatekeeper (it is an ask put to every party holding the option to challenge, who reprice it) and reversed the validity asymmetry (a validity judgment binds only the losing challenger, an invalidity judgment ends the patent everywhere, so the loop ends only in the answer the holder feared); the warranty/blindness incompatibility was stated with inverted polarity, the real one running between the warranty's escape (the knowledge group) and Blindness's mechanism (imputation), never both live under one definition of knowledge. A third edge, the cover question, stated its condition inverted, describing the case where the covert channel was never needed. All three were label repairs; the items and the forms survived them. The type held against a buyer's deal momentum, a peek that spends alpha, and the well-testing seller under a disclosure statute against the same seller under a knowledge-qualified rep.
accepted: Hard pull: the inquiry is logged where strangers read it, so the peek is priced by every party that was not asked; as the mortgage rate a borrower can learn only by applying, where the application is a hard inquiry on the credit file that every later lender sees as a search and that lowers the score it is read against, so a borrower who shops five lenders one after another arrives at the fifth as someone who has been turned down four times whether or not she was; the inquiry is the application; the commitment is a record of having asked, borne by the asker and read by parties who were never asked; the less committing inquiry is the soft pull or prequalification, which answers with an estimate rather than a rate and exists because the hard one committed, and the scoring models' rate-shopping window, in which pulls within a set span count as one, is the institution that makes the serial question askable; not lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search for its replacement, since here the readers are strangers to the source and read the count of asks rather than the fact of one.

Confidant with a duty: whom the question is put to decides what the asking commits, because the asked party's own duties are triggered by hearing it; as the founder who asks a board member whether she should take the acquisition offer and has thereby informed a director, who may be bound to bring the offer to the full board, or the controller who asks the auditor whether a booking was right and has put it in the audit file, or the child who asks the school nurse whether a bruise could have been from a parent and has crossed a mandated reporter's threshold; the inquiry is the same question in a different ear; the commitment is the ear's duty, borne by the asker as a process now running that the asker cannot stop; the less committing inquiry is the ear whose duty runs back to the asker, the lawyer under privilege, the physician under confidentiality, the priest under the seal, which is why counsel is retained before the question is asked and not after; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party holds the option and reprices it, since here the asked party holds nothing the asker wants and is committed by the question against its own preference.

Question plants itself: asking a party what it would do installs in that party a decision it was not facing, so the answer describes a party the question has changed; as the manager who asks the engineer whether she is thinking of leaving, and converts an unexamined staying into a staying that has now been chosen or not, or the spouse who asks whether the other would stay if the money ran out; the inquiry is the direct question to the subject; the commitment is that the subject now holds the option as an option, borne by the asker, who has lost the choice of keeping her by inertia and must now keep her by a decision she is also making, and who cannot again have the subject who had not thought of it; the less committing inquiry is to ask the class rather than the person, the anonymous engagement survey, or to watch rather than ask, calendar gaps and recruiter mail, each of which answers about a population or a posture and not about her; not Asking the gatekeeper, where the asked party prices something the asker wants, since here nothing is priced and what changes is which futures the asked party can see; speculative as a mechanism, since the lodging of the option in the asked party is inferred from what askers report and not measured.

Answer only inside the incision: the answer of the grade needed exists only in a state that itself demands a decision, so the deciding must happen on a provisional answer within a window the inquiry opened; as the surgeon who sends a frozen section from the operating table and gets a preliminary read while the patient is open, so that resect or close must be chosen in the anesthesia window on the fast read, since the permanent pathology arrives in days and the patient cannot be held open for it; the inquiry is the opening itself, with the sample sent from inside it, since the sample alone makes no window; the commitment is the decision made in the window on the lesser answer, borne by the patient, and the window is made by the inquiry itself; the less committing inquiry is the preoperative biopsy, which answers earlier and about less, since the margin and the node become questions only once the specimen is out, and which in some tumours carries its own commitment through seeding along the needle track, so the earlier question is not free; not Breaking to know, where the specimen is consumed and the decision moves to its siblings, since here the patient is whole and the decision is moved into the window.
